name: Couple SM80 tile shape with pipeline stage count
summary: Jointly choose the SM80 CTA tile and multistage depth because each stage allocates full A and B shared-memory tiles.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Pass ThreadblockShape and Stages into the default MMA construction that creates multistage global/shared iterators.
strategy.expected_benefit: Exposes data reuse and parallel Tensor Core work while respecting layout and resource limits.
tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.

parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: threadblock_shape.

parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: stages.

constraints.rationale: Every asynchronous pipeline stage retains operand tiles.
Larger warp/CTA tiles increase accumulator register demand.
